schema:
CREATE TABLE actor (
  ActorID,
  Biography,
  Birth City,
  Birth Country,
  Date of Birth,
  Ethnicity,
  Gender,
  Height (Inches),
  Name,
  NetWorth
);

CREATE TABLE characters (
  ActorID,
  Character Name,
  MovieID,
  creditOrder,
  pay,
  screentime
);

CREATE TABLE movie (
  Budget,
  Genre,
  Gross,
  MPAA Rating,
  MovieID,
  Rating,
  Rating Count,
  Release Date,
  Runtime,
  Summary,
  Title
);
